panels.title: Node incident lifecycle including network paths

targets.rawSql: SELECT id::text, node_id, resource, rule, severity, status, opened_at, observed_at, updated_at, resolved_at, (evidence_reloaded OR now()-observed_at > interval '15 seconds' OR observed_at-now() > interval '2 seconds') AS evidence_stale, CASE rule WHEN 'cpu_saturation' THEN (record->'latest_evidence'->>'cpu_available')::boolean WHEN 'workload_oom' THEN (record->'latest_evidence'->>'memory_available')::boolean WHEN 'inode_exhaustion' THEN (record->'latest_evidence'->>'inode_available')::boolean WHEN 'fd_pressure' THEN (record->'latest_evidence'->>'fd_available')::boolean WHEN 'network_path_degradation' THEN (record->'latest_evidence'->>'network_available')::boolean ELSE (record->'latest_evidence'->>'block_available')::boolean END AS evidence_available FROM incidents WHERE status ~ '${status:raw}' AND node_id = ${node:sqlstring} ORDER BY opened_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Node incident evidence and investigation steps

targets.rawSql: SELECT id::text, node_id, resource, status, record->>'diagnosis' AS diagnosis, jsonb_pretty(record->'configuration') AS configuration, jsonb_pretty(record->'opening_evidence') AS opening_evidence, jsonb_pretty(record->'latest_evidence') AS latest_evidence, jsonb_pretty(record->'investigation_steps') AS investigation_steps FROM incidents WHERE status ~ '${status:raw}' AND node_id = ${node:sqlstring} ORDER BY opened_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Observed local discards (agent session gauge)
panels.description: Last observed reporting, scoped to boot/agent session; may reset. Consult age/stale. Missing discards remain unavailable. Discards do not prove network loss.

panels.title: Delivery reporting available (absent is unavailable)
panels.description: Last observed reporting, scoped to boot/agent session; may reset. Consult age/stale. Missing discards remain unavailable. Discards do not prove network loss.

panels.title: Delivery observation age
panels.description: Last observed reporting, scoped to boot/agent session; may reset. Consult age/stale. Missing discards remain unavailable. Discards do not prove network loss.

panels.title: Host CPU busy
panels.description: Executed host CPU time; excludes idle, iowait, and steal.

panels.title: Host memory available
panels.description: Host scope remains separate from configured workload cgroups.

panels.title: Workload memory usage
panels.description: Ratios may temporarily exceed 100%; missing and unlimited limits remain absent.

panels.title: Workload local OOM kills
panels.description: Cumulative exact-cgroup memory.events.local counters; increases drive the rule.

panels.title: Inode diagnosis coverage
panels.description: Both inode counters and the opening block guard are available and fresh.

panels.title: FD pressure (maximum observed)
panels.description: Highest fresh exact count/current finite soft-limit ratio on this node. Missing or infinite limits remain absent, not zero.

panels.title: FD collection coverage
panels.description: Exact finite count/limit coverage and durable incident admission availability. History is not current-state proof without freshness.

panels.title: FD incident evidence
panels.description: Readable vertical detail for the latest matching FD incident: explicit incident and boot-scoped process identity, measured count/current limit, growth or unavailable state, coverage, lifecycle reason, diagnosis, and investigation steps. Positive growth supports suspected leakage; it does not prove cause.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT id, status, observed_at, evidence_reloaded, record FROM incidents WHERE rule='fd_pressure' AND status ~ '${status:raw}' AND node_id=${node:sqlstring} ORDER BY opened_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1), details AS (SELECT detail.ordinal, detail.field, detail.value FROM selected CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (10, 'Incident ID', id::text), (20, 'Status', status), (30, 'Resolution reason', COALESCE(record->>'resolution_reason','active')), (40, 'Boot ID', COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'identity'->>'boot_id','unavailable')), (50, 'PID / starttime ticks', COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'identity'->>'pid','?') || ' / ' || COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'identity'->>'starttime_ticks','?')), (60, 'Descriptor count / actual soft limit', COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'observation'->>'descriptor_count','unavailable') || ' / ' || COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'observation'->>'soft_limit','unavailable')), (70, 'Pressure ratio', COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'observation'->>'pressure_ratio','unavailable')), (80, 'Growth delta / rate / interval', COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'observation'->>'count_delta','unavailable') || ' / ' || COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'observation'->>'growth_per_second','unavailable') || ' / ' || COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'observation'->>'growth_interval_seconds','unavailable')), (90, 'Observation status / errors', COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->>'status','unknown') || ' / ' || COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'observation'->>'errors','[]')), (100, 'FD available / watch coverage', COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->>'fd_available','false') || ' / ' || COALESCE(record->'latest_evidence'->'coverage'->>'watch','unavailable')), (110, 'Evidence stale', (evidence_reloaded OR now()-observed_at > interval '15 seconds' OR observed_at-now() > interval '2 seconds')::text), (120, 'Diagnosis', COALESCE(record->>'diagnosis','unavailable'))) AS detail(ordinal,field,value)), steps AS (SELECT 200 + step.ordinality::integer AS ordinal, 'Investigation step ' || step.ordinality::text AS field, step.value FROM selected CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(record->'investigation_steps','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS step(value,ordinality)) SELECT display.field, display.value FROM (SELECT ordinal, field, value FROM details UNION ALL SELECT ordinal, field, value FROM steps) AS display ORDER BY display.ordinal

panels.title: Network packet loss
panels.description: Measured three-echo loss. Unavailable collection is absent rather than rendered as zero.

panels.title: Network successful-reply median RTT
panels.description: Median of successful replies only; no-reply and unavailable probes omit RTT.

panels.title: Host TCP retransmit rate
panels.description: Host-wide cumulative retransmit delta rate; context only, not attributed to the target or interface.

panels.title: Instantaneous TCP connection states
panels.description: Current host socket inventory gauges; never counter rates.

panels.title: Interface error and drop rates
panels.description: Per-interface context rates with bounded interface labels; not asserted as path causation.

panels.title: Network path incident evidence
panels.description: Latest matching incident with frozen configuration, measured opening/latest probe, scoped context, diagnosis and investigation steps.
